title: ClosedLoopReport
description: The report of experiment 2, closed loop (docs/design/simulation_spec.md sections 6.2 and 8): per arm the probe offset and the control excursion over the run, and for every arm but the oracle the paired difference against the oracle with a bootstrap interval across seeds. Reported, never gated: no test requires a sign, a size or an ordering of the arms. The wording of the result is the template of spec section 6.2, a model-internal effect under named assumptions, never a prediction.

mean.description: Mean over seeds of the per-seed mean over reactors of (arm minus oracle).

lo.description: Lower end of the percentile bootstrap interval across seeds.

hi.description: Upper end of the percentile bootstrap interval across seeds.

median.description: Median across seeds of the per-seed mean over reactors.

per_seed.description: The per-seed mean over reactors, in the order of `seeds`: the output per arm and seed.

paired.description: Null for the oracle, the reference of the pairing.

kind.description: A sensitivity arm is reported beside the architectures and is not a result of one.

counts.description: Readjustment slots summed over reactors and seeds: every slot is in exactly one of the next three counts. values: the offline pH values the arm held (0 for the oracle); extrapolated: those whose hold lay beyond the range their stability effect covers (A046), which carries a warning (spec section 8, rule 7).

min_seeds.description: The seed minimum of an experiment (A103).

n_reactor_pairs.description: The denominator of the pairing: reactors over the seeds, the same for every arm.

interval.description: What the median, the spread and the interval are, in words.

seed.description: The run_seed slot of the keyed stream of the bootstrap.

result_text.pattern: ^model-internal effect under assumptions A\d{3}.*, not a prediction$
